title: Haunter's Gas Tongue Has a Horrifying Rule
premise: Haunter's gaseous tongue can sap life and cause shaking that continues until death.
audiencePromise: Follow Haunter's lick from strange gas tongue to a consequence that never lets up.
openLoop: Why does Haunter's lick keep getting worse?
payoff: The lick is only the trigger. Haunter's real mechanic is the aftermath: life drains while shaking continues.
engagementQuestion: Which is worse: the life drain or endless shaking?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a disturbing surprise. Keep the pace quick, clear, and warm. Punch the words gas, life, and shaking. Pause briefly before each reveal.

scenes.headline: ONE LICK. SHAKING WON'T STOP.
scenes.narration: Haunter's gas tongue makes victims shake without stopping.
scenes.caption: ONE LICK. NO STOPPING.

scenes.headline: THE DANGER COMES IN TWO PARTS
scenes.narration: The Pokédex splits the danger in two: licking saps life, then shaking begins.
scenes.caption: LIFE DRAINS. SHAKING BEGINS.

scenes.headline: THE AFTERMATH KEEPS GROWING
scenes.narration: And this isn't a quick effect. The shaking continues until the victim's demise.
scenes.caption: IT CONTINUES UNTIL DEATH

scenes.headline: THE LICK IS ONLY THE TRIGGER
scenes.narration: The danger starts with a lick, but the real mechanic is what follows.
scenes.caption: THE AFTERMATH IS THE DANGER

scenes.headline: THE TONGUE IS MADE OF GAS
scenes.narration: Its tongue is made of gas, and shaking continues until death.
scenes.caption: GAS TONGUE. LASTING CONSEQUENCE.

scenes.headline: WHICH PART IS WORSE?
scenes.narration: Which is worse: the life drain or endless shaking?
scenes.caption: LIFE DRAIN OR ENDLESS SHAKING?
